description: Registry for rights-cleared REAL manuscript OCR evaluation images (AHAIET-052). Empty by design: no image is fabricated and none is added without documented rights and expert annotation. Each entry, when added, must name: id, image filename (kept outside source control unless the licence permits redistribution), ground_truth transcription, script_profile, language_profile, stratum (script / diacritics / degradation), rights (licence or permission statement + source), annotator (who produced the ground truth and their qualification), and sha256 of the image. training/evaluation/evaluate_ocr.py scores registry entries per stratum when present. See docs/OCR.md for the requirements.
